Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.In a quiet town, a boy named Kian found a sealed envelope buried under a tree marked with a red ribbon. The envelope had no name, only the words "Open when you feel lost." Curious, Kian waited for weeks before opening it during a tough day at school. Inside was a note that read, "You matter more than you know. Look for light, even in shadows." The message wasn’t signed, but it changed something in Kian. He started writing kind notes and hiding them in places around town—bus stops, books in the library, and park benches. Slowly, others began doing the same. Soon, strangers smiled more, and the town felt lighter. Even teachers began joining the movement. Eventually, local newspapers noticed the change and wrote about the 'Secret Kindness Notes'. No one ever found who wrote the first note, but everyone agreed: a small message, at the right time, can change a life forever—and sometimes, even an entire town.What is the correct summary of the passage?
options: Kian starts a newspaper about town secrets.
A kind letter changes a town, inspiring others to spread kindness.
A note reveals the writer’s identity in a school contest.
A boy finds a secret letter and forgets about it.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (A kind letter changes a town, inspiring others to spread kindness.) है।
